classifications.rationale: This segment merely quotes a congressional amendment to the Tariff Act; it contains no presidential governance action of its own. The statutory text governs rates directly, but the segment does not itself enact that text.
classifications.evidence: Section 350(b) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory determination that deleting specified tariff-list items is required or appropriate; the resulting deletion is designated to operate on the thirtieth day after the proclamation.

The President presently makes determinations concerning the required deletion and unnecessary continuance of specified tariff items, with the contemplated tariff consequences beginning on the thirtieth day after the proclamation.
classifications.evidence: the deletion from the list set forth in the seventh recital

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory determination supporting addition of a specified tariff item and its 44-percent ad valorem rate, to operate after thirty days.
classifications.evidence: the addition of the following item to the list

classifications.rationale: The President presently determines that a specified treaty-schedule item must be corrected; the same segment also recites existing termination authority, but does not direct a later agency decision.
classifications.evidence: I determine that it is required or appropriate

classifications.rationale: The proclamation itself prospectively deletes a tariff-list item, makes the applicable concession rate govern covered articles, and rectifies a schedule description; these legal effects arise automatically on the specified date or through the provision itself.
classifications.evidence: the rate of duty representing each concession provided for in the second item 718(a) in Part I of Schedule XX of the said general agreement shall be applied

classifications.rationale: The proclamation itself prospectively amends the incorporated tariff list by deleting the items identified in recital six, effective on the thirtieth day after the proclamation.
classifications.evidence: shall on and after the thirtieth day following the date of this proclamation be further amended

classifications.rationale: The proclamation itself prospectively amends one tariff list to add the item and rate identified in recital nine and terminates the legal effect of portions of an earlier proclamation after the twenty-ninth day.
classifications.evidence: shall not be in effect after the twenty-ninth day following the date of this proclamation
